title: [FEATURE] Multi-account switching in Claude Mobile app without shared email
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

The Claude mobile app (iOS/Android) has no way to switch between multiple accounts that use different email addresses without fully signing out and back in. The built-in account switcher only works when both accounts share the same email.
Many users have both a personal (Pro/Max) subscription and a company (Team/Enterprise) subscription tied to different email addresses. Switching between them on mobile requires a full sign-out/sign-in cycle each time, which is disruptive and time-consuming.
This is the same pain point described in #18435 for the Desktop app, but applies to the mobile app specifically.


### Proposed Solution

Add native multi-account support to the Claude mobile app, allowing users to be signed into multiple accounts (even with different emails) and switch between them from the profile/initials menu — without losing context or requiring re-authentication.

### Alternative Solutions

**Workarounds**
Using the Claude mobile app for one account and claude.ai in a mobile browser for the other
Or signing out and back in each time not getting notified 



### Priority

Medium - Would be very helpful

### Feature Category

CLI commands and flags

### Use Case Example

_No response_

### Additional Context

**Related Issues**
[#18435 — Same feature request for Claude Desktop](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/18435)

top_comments.body:
+1 on this. I run Claude Code locally on my work machine (Team plan) and use the Claude iOS app for my personal Pro subscription. With Remote Control now available, I'd love to control my local sessions from my phone — but I can't without logging out of my personal account and back into my work account every time.

The browser workaround (claude.ai in browser for work, native app for personal) works but it's clunky. Native multi-account switching on mobile would make Remote Control actually usab
